li.label: someone was glad to see me
li.description: I came home filthy and done in, and my animal acted like I'd hung the moon. It's nice to be somebody's favorite.

li.label: warm feet
li.description: Something heavy and warm sleeps across my feet these nights. It snores. I've decided I don't mind.

li.label: lost my dinner to an animal
li.description: Turned my head for one breath and my dinner was gone. Not all of it. The good part.

li.label: the best bite, stolen
li.description: It took the one piece I'd been saving for last and didn't even chew it properly. A perfect bite, wasted on an animal.

li.label: robbed, adorably
li.description: An animal stole my dinner right off the plate and looked so pleased about it that I couldn't be angry.

li.label: a gift, technically
li.description: My animal brought me something dead and laid it at my feet like treasure. It's the thought that counts. It's mostly the thought.

li.label: taught my animal a trick
li.description: Days of patience and pocketfuls of scraps, and now it does the thing when I ask. Sometimes. I'm very proud of us both.

li.label: my animal knew
li.description: I didn't tell anyone how bad it was. I didn't have to tell my animal. It just came and stayed.

li.label: my things got chewed
li.description: Something I needed is now in several damp pieces. I know exactly who did it, and it knows that I know.

li.label: cleaned up after a larder raid
li.description: One of the animals got into the stores and I was the one who found the mess. The smell stays on your hands all day.

li.label: played with an animal all day
li.description: We ran around until we both fell over, and then we lay in the grass. That was the best part.

li.label: an animal chose me
li.description: It isn't even mine, but it follows me everywhere and waits for me at the door. Out of everyone here, it picked me.

li.label: told my troubles to an animal
li.description: I said it all out loud to something that won't repeat it or have an opinion. I feel lighter.

li.label: an animal hates me
li.description: One animal in this colony has decided I'm the enemy. I've done nothing to it. It doesn't care.

li.label: company at work
li.description: My animal lay nearby while I worked all day. The hours go quicker with someone watching who thinks you're wonderful.

li.label: my old friend is slowing down
li.description: It's slower to get up every morning, and it still comes to find me. I'm trying not to count how many mornings are left.

li.label: new life in the barn
li.description: Tiny, loud, wobbling things in the straw. Something out here is being born instead of dying, for once.

li.label: the herd is growing
li.description: More animals in the barn: more hide, more meat, more labor later on. A sound investment, and nobody had to pay for it.

li.label: my animal stood guard
li.description: A stranger came too close, and my animal stepped between us without being told. I didn't know it would do that for me.

li.label: kept awake by the noise
li.description: My animal spent half the night crying at the dark. Neither of us slept. Only one of us got a nap afterwards.

li.label: noises in the dark
li.description: Every sound outside last night was something coming for me. None of them were. My heart didn't believe that.

li.label: calls in the dark
li.description: Something past the fields called all night, and something farther off answered. I don't like being in the middle of a conversation I can't follow.

li.label: something worth hunting
li.description: There's a real animal out there. Big, clever, dangerous. My hands keep reaching for a blade on their own.

li.label: saw a great beast
li.description: It crossed the meadow, huge and slow and completely uninterested in us. I've been smiling at nothing all day.

li.label: close to a great beast
li.description: I got near enough to smell it: dust, grass and something very old. I've worked with animals all my life and never felt this small.

li.label: a quiet morning
li.description: An animal in the mist, nobody else awake, nothing burning or bleeding. For a whole minute this place was just beautiful.

li.label: watched a herd go by
li.description: The whole herd went past, taking its time, while I stood and watched. The world out there doesn't know we exist. That's oddly restful.

li.label: birdsong
li.description: Birds in the hedges all morning, something small asleep in the sun. For a few hours I forgot to listen for raiders.

li.label: being watched
li.description: Something out past the fence spent the day watching me work. Not the way you watch a person. The way you watch food.

li.label: I felt like prey
li.description: My legs knew before I did. I keep looking at the long grass, waiting for it to move.

li.label: something is eating the crops
li.description: I plant them, I water them, I weed them, and something small with no manners eats them. This is war now.

li.label: fed a wild creature
li.description: A wild thing ate out of my hand today. It didn't trust me, not really. It was just hungrier than it was scared.

li.label: a wild animal came to me
li.description: A real wild animal came right up to me and I didn't scream or run, and it liked me. I'm going to remember this when I'm old.

li.label: something huge is out there
li.description: I put my hand in one of its footprints and there was room to spare. It's out there now, somewhere, walking around.

li.label: touched a wild beast
li.description: I put my hand right on it. Everyone said I was mad. My heart is still going like a drum.

li.label: it's still out there
li.description: I saw it again at the tree line. The same beast. The old wounds ached just from looking, as if they remembered.

li.label: come and try it
li.description: That beast came back to look at me. Let it look. Next time I'll be the one walking toward it.

li.label: that beast is back
li.description: The animal that mauled one of ours was seen again. I keep a blade close and I don't walk out alone.

li.label: robbed by a wild animal
li.description: A wild animal walked off with my things in broad daylight, and the worst part is that everybody saw.

li.label: night-time company
li.description: Out walking in the dark again, and a wild animal crossed my path and didn't run. We keep the same hours, it and I.

li.label: watched a fight in the meadow
li.description: Two of them crashed heads in the meadow for an hour. Best entertainment we've had all season, and nobody bled but them.
